pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large irregular polygonal patches with soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. Patch size is maximal on the upper flank and decreases sharply towards the lower leg and belly regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways with primarily tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of corridors remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Dark mane along the upper neck showing a low-amplitude jagged silhouette against the light background.
